name: combat2d
description: Dying and killing, in the simplest form: a Mortal dies when it touches a harmful layer or falls off the bottom of the screen, and then says so to the game (an action, which a scene change or a rule can listen to); a Projectile destroys what it hits, or hurts a Target that has several lives.

components.name: Mortal
components.description: The entity can die. It dies when its Contacts touch a collider of one of hurt_layers (it needs a Collider and a Contacts), or, if fall_death is on, when it is more than fall_margin units under the bottom edge of the screen (y grows downwards). `dead` then stays true and, once, the action on_death is raised (a field of the game's `action` list), which a GoToScene can use to show a game over. Nothing else happens to the entity itself: the game decides what a death means.

components.name: Target
components.description: The entity can be shot: it loses `health` points for the damage of each Projectile that touches it (it needs a Collider), and is destroyed when none are left.

components.name: Projectile
components.description: The entity hurts the first Target whose Collider it overlaps, by damage points, and is destroyed by the hit. It needs a Collider and moves by its own Velocity (and a Lifetime lets it end by itself).

systems.name: shots
systems.description: Lets every Projectile hit the Targets it overlaps: the Target loses health and is destroyed at 0, the Projectile is destroyed.

systems.name: hurt
systems.description: Kills every Mortal whose Contacts touch one of its hurt_layers, or that fell under the screen.

systems.name: announce
systems.description: Raises the on_death action of every Mortal that has just died, once.
